declaration.negotiation_history_statement: As interim class counsel, we negotiated the proposed settlement through multiple exchanges with Brightline’s counsel. The parties negotiated class relief and attorneys’ fees during the same exchanges; we cannot represent that fees were discussed only after class relief was agreed. The resulting agreement provides a $31.5 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified class members without a claims process, and a separate $4 million provision for fees and expenses, subject to court approval. Brightline has not agreed to refrain from opposing the fee request, and any fees the Court does not award will go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. We submit the settlement for preliminary approval, subject to the Court’s independent review and notice to the class.
